definition: Operations that find data products in catalogues and retrieve their data: selecting products by area, time and metadata, and retrieving bands or areas of a product, without computing new quantities from them -- independent of any input/output signature or implementation (OGC 14-065 WPS 2.0.2 §7.5.1).
